title: Crestline Fleet Account Restored Brake Discount and Shop Supplies Deduction
content:
**Clause.** On a Crestline Fleet Account, the correction is made on the account's most recent brake invoice posted with no fleet discount, and the brake jobs behind it are the brake warranties of that vehicle with a service date equal to the invoice date, one per axle; on an account invoiced with sales tax this rule credits nothing and the base rule governs. The discount the brake jobs should have carried is the program's brakes discount applied to the ticket's discountable brake price, which is the invoice amount plus any discount already taken, less the shop supplies fee of the repair order (the shop supplies fee percent of the labor charged on its brake jobs, capped at the shop supplies fee cap, rounded half up to the cent), and it is nothing when a brake job on the ticket is on a line on which the fleet account's brakes discount does not apply; the discount is rounded half up to the cent, the correction is that discount less the discount already taken, never below 0.00, and it never exceeds the invoice amount less the credit memos and early-pay discounts already on the invoice.

## Program brakes discount

| Program | Brakes discount (percent) |
|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 5 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 10 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 12 |
| Crestline Fleet National | 15 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 18 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 15 |

## What the terms refer to

- **The brake jobs**: the Brake Service Warranties recorded for the invoice's vehicle with a service date equal to the invoice date, at most one front-axle job and one rear-axle job.
- **The shop supplies fee of the repair order**: the shop supplies fee percent of the brake line, applied to the labor charged on those brake jobs together, capped at the line's shop supplies fee cap, then rounded half up to the cent. With no brake job recorded, there is no shop supplies fee to take off.
- **A line on which the brakes discount does not apply**: a brake warranty line whose terms say the fleet account's brakes discount does not apply when the job is charged to a fleet account.

## Worked figures (hypothetical ticket, program brakes discount of 12 percent, shop supplies 5 percent capped at 35.00)

1. Invoice amount 640.00, discount already taken 0.00; front and rear jobs with labor of 110.00 each.
2. Shop supplies fee: 5 percent of 220.00 is 11.00, under the 35.00 cap: 11.00.
3. Discountable brake price: 640.00 less 11.00, that is 629.00.
4. Discount: 12 percent of 629.00 is 75.48; less 0.00 already taken: 75.48, within the ceiling of 640.00.

Had either job been on a line on which the brakes discount does not apply, the discount would be nothing.
